title: Soul Night Market – Sorrento Beach
summary: Evening street-food and makers market on the Sorrento foreshore: local stalls, food trucks, music, monthly across the warmer months.
accessibilityNotes: Beach foreshore; uneven sand surface; limited accessibility
nearbyAttractions: Sorrento main street dining; Searoad Ferry; Hotel Sorrento
suggestedItineraryPairing: Evening market then Sorrento dining or drinks
editorVerdict: Sunset on the back beach side of the Peninsula, food trucks lined up, a low murmur of holidaymakers. The setting does almost all of the lifting.
editorNote:
Soul Night Market on Sorrento Beach is the warmer-weather cousin of the Mornington version, and the setting is the whole pitch: bay edge, late-afternoon light, food trucks and makers as the sun drops.

It only runs on selected nights across autumn and spring, so check the date before driving down. Park up Ocean Beach Road or in the village and walk in (the foreshore carparks fill).

Make an evening of it: market for dinner, then a wine at Hotel Sorrento or the Continental. Sand surface means heels and prams struggle.
kidsGradeNote: Beach foreshore is sandy and uneven, so prams are awkward. Older kids love the food trucks; bring a torch for the walk back.
